findings.evidence: AstraSight.log: 10 freezes 07:31:58-07:32:21 (cadence ~2.27 s) while Papyrus.0.log has no OnKeyDown after 07:31:59
findings.cause: RequestShot arms repeatFire after InputReady yields (Utility.IsInMenuMode); an OnKeyUp processed inside that yield is overwritten. A lost release (unregistered menu, focus loss) has the same effect: nothing re-checks the physical key.

findings.evidence: 07:30:03 NATIVE_SIGHT_SAMPLE_FAILED right after calibration epoch=2, gun at yaw 0
findings.cause: player heading float(pi) > pi makes the sampled yaw 359.999995; CaptureAim returns float 360.0 and Papyrus rejects nextYaw >= 360

findings.evidence: 07:32:21 session ends with NATIVE_SIGHT_THAW_FAILED; native session silently invalidated (no warn line)
findings.cause: a menu that changes the camera state (TweenMenu) makes AstraSight invalidate the sight; Papyrus then ends the session instead of re-entering after the menu
findings.status: mechanism from code; menu name not traced in v08

findings.evidence: "OPERATOR_OUT_OF_RANGE dx=-63 dy=56 dz=-11" while the limit is 160 u horizontal and 64 u vertical
findings.cause: sight-mode CanOperate does not call NearOperator; the shot rejection appends the stale operatorFailure text written at activation

findings.evidence: screenshot 07:31:20 (session active, epoch 6, no invalidation until 07:32:21) matches the player-eye render at yaw 180, not the sight render
findings.cause: unknown: the rendered camera is not the one AstraSight writes; straight and swept eye-to-sight lines clear the real Havok collision by 123 u (camera collision ruled out)
findings.status: open; v09 records the rendered camera natively
findings.prior_report: v06 user: camera drifts beyond 180; v07 post-camera write did not fix it

findings.evidence: QA profile installs v08 torre.nif; the rustic tower lived in Ballesta_Astra_Escalera_Rustica_v01
findings.cause: not installed, and the change was subtle
findings.status: v09 adopts it with stronger irregularity
